videos.title: Ballroom Blitz! 1967-1976
videos.description: Celebrating the colourful world of glam rock, novelty pop and unforgettable chart hits that defined a distinctive era in UK music. Expect TV themes, Eurovision and plenty of glitter!

videos.title: 70s Glam Slam!
videos.description: Rewind to a time of big hair, outrageous makeup and platform shoes. The greatest gems of glam pop and rock, including Queen, ABBA and Wizzard.

videos.title: Every No.1 of the 70s!
videos.description: Our most complete list yet of UK number 1s of the decade! Some songs just don't have videos, but 141 chart toppers do, and here they are - in order!

videos.title: A Whole Lotta Love!
videos.description: It's not Led Zepp, but non-stop love songs, back to back, from the era of Leo Sayer, Carpenters, The Bee Gees & Minnie Riperton.

videos.title: Ultimate Love Songs! 1970-1979
videos.description: From 'Ticket to Ride' in 1970 to 'Please Don't Go' in 1979, these are simply the 50 biggest love and break-up songs of the decade.

videos.title: Simon Bates' Rock Ballads! 1970-79
videos.description: We didn't yet call them Power Ballads, but some masters of the genre - Boston, Toto and Whitesnake - were already at it. 25 power pop love songs and ballads of the 70s - in order!

videos.title: I'm Stone In Love With You!
videos.description: Crackling vinyl, shag carpets & lava lamp glows - this is how we loved in the 70s! Oh, James...

videos.title: So Here It Is, Merry Christmas!
videos.description: Forget the imitations, this is the genuine article, NOW That's What I Call Christmas! With heaps of happy hits from the 1950s, 60s and 70s.

videos.title: 10 Classic Christmas Cuddles!
videos.description: Laid-back love songs & easy-listening classics for the festive period. With Mud, Carpenters, Greg Lake & Johnny Matthis.

videos.title: So Here It Is, Merry Christmas!
videos.description: Forget the imitations, this is the genuine article, NOW That's What I Call Christmas! With heaps of happy hits from the 1950s, 60s and 70s.

videos.title: Bruno Brookes UK Top 40 of Xmas
videos.description: A definite countdown of the UK's biggest Christmas singles of all time, spanning seven decades of seasonal songs. Bruno Brookes has the festive facts and figures at hand.

videos.title: As Noddy Says... It's Christmaaas!
videos.description: Feel-good hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready?

videos.title: 60s v 70s Christmas!
videos.description: 60 minutes of Christmas classics - 1 from the 60s followed by another from the 70s.

videos.title: Tony's Sensational 70s Xmas!
videos.description: Tinsel Tony with tons of terrific tunes and festive fun for Christmas - all from the 1970s!

videos.title: As Noddy Says... It's Christmaaas!
videos.description: Feel-good hits & festive favourites from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Santa hat, platform boots & tinsel at the ready?

videos.title: Top Xmas Singalongs! 1970-1979
videos.description: In order - 5 hours of the biggest festive karaoke anthems of the 70s - from Paul McCartney & T.Rex to Abba, Wizzard & Slade. Prepare to sing out loud!

videos.title: Eat To The Beat! Top 30
videos.description: The 70s and 80s were full of edible bands and songs, and TV chef Rustie Lee has raided the fridge and pantry to serve up pop's sweet treats. It is going to be a riot.

videos.title: Boogie Nights!
videos.description: If you don't get up and dance, you aren't human. Disco was the best floor show in town and once again it's time to get up and get lost in the pulse.

videos.title: Pat Sharp's Disco Explosion!
videos.description: Get down to Studio 54 with ABBA on songwriting duties, the Bee Gees on production, Chic's string section and Pat Sharp on rhythm guitar!

videos.title: Pat Sharp's Disco Explosion!
videos.description: Get down to Studio 54 with ABBA on songwriting duties, the Bee Gees on production, Chic's string section and Pat Sharp on rhythm guitar!

videos.description: If you don't get up and dance, you aren't human. Disco was the best floor show in town and once again it's time to get up and get lost in the pulse.

videos.description: 25 of the campest and glitziest disco videos known to man. Sunglasses at the ready, because you'll be blinded by the bright lights and bling!

videos.description: Forget the imitations, this is the genuine article, NOW That's What I Call Christmas! With heaps of happy hits from the 1950s, 60s and 70s.

videos.title: It Spent HOW Long at No.1?!
videos.description: Once these tracks made it to the top spot there was no knocking them off. This is a countdown of the 50 longest chart toppers of the 1970s.

videos.title: So Here It Is, Merry Christmas!
videos.description: Forget the imitations, this is the genuine article, NOW That's What I Call Christmas! With heaps of happy hits from the 1950s, 60s and 70s.

videos.title: Pat Sharp's One Hit Wonders! 70-79
videos.description: A look at 40 acts from every year of the 70s, in order, who all achieved their 15 minutes of fame.

videos.title: Let The Good Times Roll!
videos.description: From hippies to punk rockers, via folk, funk, soul & disco - these are the classic songs that made the 70s!

videos.title: Wot? They Streamed a Billion?
videos.description: What 70s songs have streamed over a billion times worldwide? There are lots from Rumours & Queen's Greatest, but the songs at 4, 9, 12 & 18 might surprise you!

videos.title: 1978 Unleashed!
videos.description: Classic hits from just 1 year - 1978!

videos.title: 1978's One-Hit-Wonders! Top 10
videos.description: 10 artists that had a single big song in 1979 - then never darkened the UK Top 20 ever again! Remember Frankie Miller, City Boy or Raffaella Carra?

videos.title: It's 1978 Night!
videos.description: All Night, classic hits from just one year, 1978!

videos.title: The NOW Yearbook 1978
videos.description: 1978 was another top year in music, as rock stars sang disco, everyone caught a bit of Saturday Night Fever and Grease was the word! Simon Bates has the story - month by month.

videos.title: It's 1978 Night!
videos.description: All Night, classic hits from just one year, 1978!

videos.title: The Best 1978 Party...Ever!
videos.description: Get ready to turn your telly up with the greatest party anthems from 1978, including Grease, Saturday Night Fever, Blondie, Ian Dury, Dan Hartman and Chic.

videos.title: Hamilton's Million Sellers! 70-79
videos.description: David Hamilton with 30 famous songs, three from every year. Each was a million-selling single or from a million-selling album, either in the UK or around the world.

videos.title: Sensational 70s!
videos.description: From the era of Glam Rock, New Wave & Disco - it's all the hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots & flares at the ready?

videos.description: All 70s - 24/7 - feelgood pop from the decade of glam, disco, punk & new wave!
